title: Java Engineer Broadway | Trading Platforms @ING Hubs Romania
full_description:
ING Hubs Romania offers 130 services in software development, data management, non-financial risk & compliance, audit, and retail operations to 24 ING units worldwide, with the help of 𝐨𝐯𝐞𝐫 𝟐𝟎𝟎𝟎𝐡𝐢𝐠𝐡-𝐩𝐞𝐫𝐟𝐨𝐫𝐦𝐢𝐧𝐠𝐞𝐧𝐠𝐢𝐧𝐞𝐞𝐫𝐬, 𝐫𝐢𝐬𝐤, 𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐨𝐩𝐞𝐫𝐚𝐭𝐢𝐨𝐧𝐬𝐩𝐫𝐨𝐟𝐞𝐬𝐬𝐢𝐨𝐧𝐚𝐥𝐬.
We started out in 2015 as ING’s software development hub, then steadily expanded our range to include more services and competencies. Now we provide borderless services with bank-wide capabilities and 𝐨𝐩𝐞𝐫𝐚𝐭𝐞 𝐟𝐫𝐨𝐦 𝐭𝐰𝐨 𝐥𝐨𝐜𝐚𝐭𝐢𝐨𝐧𝐬: 𝐁𝐮𝐜𝐡𝐚𝐫𝐞𝐬𝐭 𝐚𝐧𝐝𝐂𝐥𝐮𝐣-𝐍𝐚𝐩𝐨𝐜𝐚.
𝐎𝐮𝐫 𝐭𝐞𝐜𝐡𝐜𝐚𝐩𝐚𝐛𝐢𝐥𝐢𝐭𝐢𝐞𝐬𝐫𝐞𝐦𝐚𝐢𝐧 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐜𝐨𝐫𝐞 𝐨𝐟 𝐨𝐮𝐫 𝐛𝐮𝐬𝐢𝐧𝐞𝐬𝐬, with more than 1800 colleagues active in Data Management, Touchpoint Channels & Integration, Core Banking, and Global Products.
We enjoy a flexible way of working and a highly collaborative environment, where fair and constructive feedback is encouraged.
For us, impact isn't a perk. It's the driver of our work. We are guided and rewarded by a shared desire to make the world a better place, one innovative solution at a time. Our colleagues make it their job to do impactful things and they love doing it in good company. Do you?
ING is looking for driven Java Dev Engineers, with a focus on quality and delivery, to work on the FX and Money Markets trading platforms. The in-house built high-performance pricing systems and interfaces, together with the vendor-built trading/quoting systems, time-series databases and complex event processing engines are key platforms for the real-time low-latency landscape in scope of the growing Financial Markets domain.
ING is using this environment to connect to a large amount of trading exchanges worldwide to offer the sharpest pricing quotes and executions to our clients. Therefore, these systems are on dedicated infrastructure in special data centers located in close proximity to the key markets.
The Development team consists currently of 4 developers (3 engineers and one Front Office Quant) in Bucharest working directly with the algotrading team from London.
Even if you’ll start your day from the comfort of your home or drink your morning coffee in our office’s garden, your day will be quite similar when comes to tasks. Here are your daily responsibilities:
Delivery and Improvements:
Design and develop new features from scratch and improve existing ones;
Do code reviews, write unit tests, make code refactoring and take care of technical debt;
Align and discuss solutions directly with eTraders;
Work in an agile environment, based on a lot of research, collaboration and "learn from failure" way of working, with highly impactful deliveries;
Have a direct impact on the business improvements through developing and being part of the strategic deliveries;
Provide hands-on support to colleagues when investigating production issues/outages.
What you’ll bring to the team
Experience: 5+ years of industry experience in IT (dev);
Tech stack/ knowledge:
Mandatory:Understanding of Continuous Delivery concepts. Interactions with tools such as Git, Azure DevOps, Maven;Experience with building services from scratch and developing on top of existing components;Experience with the entire software development life cycle;Strong design (patterns), algorithms and data structures knowledge;Highly proficient development skills – core server-side Java, multi-threading;
Understanding of Continuous Delivery concepts. Interactions with tools such as Git, Azure DevOps, Maven;
Experience with building services from scratch and developing on top of existing components;
Experience with the entire software development life cycle;
Strong design (patterns), algorithms and data structures knowledge;
Highly proficient development skills – core server-side Java, multi-threading;
Nice to have:Experience with managing full-stack vendor packages, and additionally (low latency) infrastructural stack knowledge.Experience or affinity with IT Risk & Security concepts.Experience with messaging technologies and protocols.Experience in optimizing software for performance.Banking/Financial Markets products/processes knowledge (FX Products, FIX protocol).Flexibility in development technologies. Expected to work with different technologies and languages (KDB, Proprietary Software, Java, Python).Experience with quant development, pricing algorithms or trading strategies;
Experience with managing full-stack vendor packages, and additionally (low latency) infrastructural stack knowledge.
Experience or affinity with IT Risk & Security concepts.
Experience with messaging technologies and protocols.
Experience in optimizing software for performance.
Banking/Financial Markets products/processes knowledge (FX Products, FIX protocol).
Flexibility in development technologies. Expected to work with different technologies and languages (KDB, Proprietary Software, Java, Python).
Experience with quant development, pricing algorithms or trading strategies;
Foreign languages:English (advanced).
Education: nice to have Bachelor’s Degree (or higher) in an IT related field.
